promotions.name: Stadtwerke Schwäbisch Gmünd
promotions.resolution: Current first-party Stadtwerke Schwäbisch Gmünd Lade-Zugang page explicitly separates spontaneous/ad-hoc charging from the registered Gmünder Fahrstrom tariff and states that the utility operates 117 charging points. The published Ad-Hoc-Laden tariff is 1.00 EUR start fee, AC 0.60 EUR/kWh, DC 0.70 EUR/kWh, plus 0.10 EUR/min blocking fee after 240 minutes. This is sufficient first-party network-scope evidence for the operator's current ad-hoc energy and fee matrix; no registered-card or roaming price is substituted.
